decisions.reason: Although no longer separately visible, document capture fits the firm's digital document workflow direction and likely meets aspirations, so slack supports keeping it with a moderate drop risk.
Email-fax conversion still serves fax-dependent German customers and builds on established capabilities, and organizational slack allows carrying it while results remain uncertain.
Fax delivery optimization is a narrow feature with no website presence and likely below aspirations, so problemistic search leads to dropping it and reallocating resources.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses ongoing security needs and likely meets aspirations, so it is retained despite limited visibility.
